name: TANMAY JANA
quote: An excellent academic by Bapan photography! I've done lots of monochrome photography over the year,I learned a lot from this. Overall experience good. Specially thanks to Bapan da ❤️

name: Daniel Osei
quote: We hired Marlowe for an editorial campaign expecting polish. What we got was polish with a pulse — every frame felt lived-in rather than staged.

name: Sofia Marchetti
quote: I've never liked photos of myself until this session. She made the whole thing feel like a conversation, not a shoot.

name: James Whitfield
quote: Four sessions completely changed how I look at light. I came in with a camera I was scared of and left with a set of negatives I'm proud of.

name: Renata Alves
quote: The gallery arrived faster than any photographer we've used before, and every single image was one we wanted to print.
